sources.title: Architecture graph for OrionLLM/GRM-3.2-Cliff. - hfviewer
sources.snippet: OrionLLM/GRM-3.2-Cliff architecture at a glance OrionLLM/GRM-3.2-Cliff is an image-text-to-text model (qwen3_5_text architecture). It uses 32 transformer layers, a hidden size of 4,096, and 16 query heads with 4 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 12,288.
